posts.title: On LLMs: Do the benefits outweigh the costs?
posts.description: There's a rather common sentiment (on the internet anyway) that the utility of LLMs always usurps any negative criticisms. Built on stolen data? Oh well, the technology is here to stay. Energy use? Water? Cost of computing hardware? Bah, don't be such a luddite! This is game changing stuff right here. posts.title: Why I quit programming
posts.description: I'm something like 3 years now on my Sabbatical . Which, of course, is an extremely privileged place to be and I am filled with gratitude. At the same time, I really need to start getting clear on what I want to do for money. So, it's time to reflect on why I quit in the first place.
